Watching Lindsey Vonn rebuild her squat is a beautiful example.⁠

The squat is already a movement her brain and body understand. So instead of abandoning that language during rehab, you can start manipulating the variables around it.⁠
⁠
Give more stability. Limit the range. Slow down the tempo. Use a box, add assistance, or change the load. Start with what you can tolerate today, then progressively move the dial as capacity returns.⁠
